extra_quotes: An a.c. excitation current Iω with a frequency of 31 Hz was applied using a current source (Keithley 6221).
The longitudinal and Hall voltages at the first-, second- and third-harmonic frequencies were detected using lock -in amplifiers (Stanford Research Systems SR830).
All transport measurements were performed in a Cryomagnetics cryostat.
Determining the exact microscopic origin requires further local structural characterization , which is beyond the scope of this work.
